content.short: Lagoon is an EVM infrastructure to launch, manage and scale on-chain vaults.
content.description: Lagoon provides a vault infrastructure designed to distribute on-chain yield efficiently. Built on Safe and leveraging ERC-7540 and Zodiac modules, Lagoon offers a modular, standards-based framework that lets each curator tailor the vault environment to their exact needs. This ranges from bespoke onboarding flows to precise governance controls, including full control over stakeholder spending permissions. In practice, Lagoon empowers diverse projects to deploy and manage on-chain yield with clarity and security.
